style_scope: Nature-style data visualization within the existing ACL double-column manuscript

budget.question: How does complete risk evidence change as the search budget expands, and what happens to core compactness?
budget.claim: The saved GPT-4o trajectory gains complete risk evidence early and ends at 75% Risk-all while retaining 51.26% compression.
budget.mapping: CSV budget -> x; risk_all and compression -> percent y; n=80 at every one of the 60 prefixes
budget.uncertainty: None supplied; no repeated-run interval inferred
budget.exclusions: None: all 60 saved budget values shown in each panel
budget.transforms: Multiply fraction by 100 only; no smoothing or interpolation
budget.references: One-shot and LEA final accepted values as constant horizontal comparisons

case.question: Which clauses and risk endpoints are retained by the three methods on the same fixed case?
case.claim: Both LEA and SA-MCGS retain the two risk endpoints, with SA-MCGS using nine rather than twelve nodes.
case.mapping: shared_node_positions -> unchanged 25 positions; selected_nodes -> fill state; method -> color; root/witness -> diamond outline
case.summary: Aligned five-row table preserves nodes retained, Root@3, Risk-any, Risk-all, and compression for each method
case.uncertainty: Not applicable: one preserved fixed instance
case.exclusions: None: all 25 nodes and all 15 summary values shown
case.topology: No edges are fabricated or implied
case.category_change: Selection uses method color and fill rather than the earlier affected-context palette; endpoint identity remains explicit
